description: For jobsite safety, this log form records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

blocks.guidance: Link this jobsite safety record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces for this jobsite safety.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces for this jobsite safety record.
sections.title: Log Coverage and Custodian

blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every jobsite safety evidence source.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Keep jobsite safety items open through verification.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Open Items and Next Actions

blocks.guidance: Transfer unresolved jobsite safety entries by reference.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Period Reconciliation

blocks.guidance: For jobsite safety, explain competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger; transfer each jobsite safety open entry to the jobsite safety successor record and named owner.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Period Transfer Notes

blocks.guidance: Stop work for uncontrolled energy, fall exposure, excavation instability, missing protection, or imminent danger. Route unresolved jobsite safety work for review.
blocks.label: Jobsite Safety Applicable Review Boundary

sections.title: Dated Events and Supporting Facts

subtitle: Jobsite Safety Log Form: jobsite hazard assessment and control verification using work zone, task hazards, and pre-task briefing record.
title: Jobsite Safety Log Form
use_case: Use the log form during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
